quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:

options.text: Use low beam headlights.
Use high beam headlights.
Use parking lights.
Use no lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in rain. They help you see the road better without reflecting off the rain.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Detour.
Low shoulder.
Fire station.
Narrow bridge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Detour.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction. This sign tells you to take a different route because the main road is blocked.

questions.question: If traffic signals at an intersection are not working due to a power outage:

options.text: Park your vehicle off the road and wait for power to be restored.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat the intersection as a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the intersection as a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is broken, treat it like a four-way stop. Stop completely, let other drivers go in turn, and drive through slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop.
Fines double in a work zone.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:

options.text: Loss of hearing.
Pollution.
Carbon monoxide poisoning.
Poor engine performance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes harmful gases from your car. If it leaks, these gases can enter the passenger area. Fix leaks immediately to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: Signs that drivers must follow are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. If you don't follow them, you can receive a ticket.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line down the middle. What does this tell you?

options.text: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
Traffic moves in only one direction on this road.
The road is being repaired.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can cross it to pass slower traffic when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not turn when the light is red.
Narrow bridge ahead.
Yield ahead.
T-shaped intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that turning right on a red light is not allowed at this traffic signal. You must wait for a green light to turn.

questions.question: You must stop completely at an intersection, let other traffic and pedestrians cross, then go when it is safe. Which traffic light is this?

options.text: Solid red light.
Flashing yellow light.
Solid green light.
Flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a "No stopping" sign mean?

options.text: You can stop to unload packages.
You can stop to prevent a crash.
You can stop to let out passengers.
You can stop for less than five minutes.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can stop to prevent a crash.
questions.explanation: A "No stopping" sign means you can only stop in three cases: to obey a traffic light, to obey a police officer, or to prevent a crash with another vehicle.

questions.question: Why should drivers watch carefully for motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers did not see motorcycles, bicycles, or pedestrians. These are smaller and harder to notice than cars. Drivers must always watch for these road users to prevent crashes.

questions.question: When must you yield to other drivers?

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left at an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when entering a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on any intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive so poorly that they may look drunk.
Can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.
Are usually only older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive so poorly that they may look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so badly that they appear drunk. Opening a window, turning up the radio, or drinking coffee will not keep a drowsy driver awake.

questions.question: When a transit vehicle signals to enter traffic after a stop, you must:

options.text: Honk to let them know you are there.
Move to the left lane.
Yield.
Speed up to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any transit vehicle signaling to enter the road after stopping. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to let the bus safely enter traffic.

questions.question: Traffic lanes moving in opposite directions are divided by ____ lines.

options.text: White
Red
Black
Yellow

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest driving season.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid often in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are the best choice for your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other bad weather. Winter is the hardest driving season. Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires help your car grip slippery roads better.

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the road mean?

options.text: Drivers in that lane may move in the direction of the arrow if they want to.
Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow only if traffic lights are broken.
Drivers in that lane must always stop before moving in the direction of the arrow.
Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow while following traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow while following traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow on the road tells drivers they must move in that direction. Follow all traffic signs and signals before moving in the direction the arrow shows.

questions.question: In bad weather, what should drivers do?

options.text: Drive faster to reach their destination sooner.
Drive closer to the car in front.
Increase the distance between their car and the car in front.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the distance between their car and the car in front.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, keep more space between your car and the car ahead of you.

questions.question: What should you do on slippery roads?

options.text: Slow down.
Drive faster.
Drive at the speed limit and stay alert.
Do not drive faster than 20 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Slow down when the road is wet, snowy, or icy. These conditions make roads slippery. You may need to drive slower than the posted speed limit for safety.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering full parking lots.
Entering road construction areas.
Entering dead-end streets.
Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means traffic flows in one direction only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Only use your mirrors.
Signal after you start moving into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.
Always check your blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Other vehicles hide in your blind spot where you cannot see them. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before you change lanes or turn on residential streets. On a freeway, signal five seconds before changing lanes.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, a pedestrian should walk on the:

options.text: Side with the lightest traffic.
Side where traffic moves in the same direction as you.
Side facing oncoming traffic.
Side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you can see traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: A red circle with a slash through it means:

options.text: Come to a complete stop.
An action is not allowed.
Some drivers must yield to other drivers.
Drive slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: An action is not allowed.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a black symbol means that action is prohibited. These signs are rectangular with a white background and red and black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School ahead.
School crossing.
Pedestrian crossing.
Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow backgrounds. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that people may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for trucks.
Do not pass trucks.
Truck parking area ahead.
Steep downgrade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
The road curves ahead.
Intersections are coming up.
Road construction is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
No parking.
No U-turn.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. You should drive slower than the posted limit in bad weather or unsafe conditions.

questions.question: What should car drivers know about large trucks?

options.text: They have large blind spots.
They can stop faster than cars.
They need the same space as cars to turn and stop.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They have large blind spots.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have blind spots in front, on the sides, and in the back. Stay away from these areas. Trucks are bigger and heavier than cars. They need more space to turn and stop.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause your engine to use too much oil.
Mean your vehicle needs a tune-up sooner.
Make you feel sleepy while driving.
Start fires in grass on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you feel sleepy while driving.
questions.explanation: A leaky exhaust system releases harmful fumes into your car. These fumes can make you drowsy and put you in danger. This is a serious safety risk.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to alert the children.
Honk your horn so children can hear you.
Walk behind the car to check that the path is clear.
Tell the children to move away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk behind the car to check that the path is clear.
questions.explanation: Always exit your vehicle and look behind it before backing up. Do not trust only your mirrors, especially around children. Children can be hard to see from inside the car.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.
One-way traffic.
Cattle crossing ahead.
Two-way left turn lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must first yield to any oncoming traffic. Turn left only when it is safe and the road is clear.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop your car?

options.text: Signal lights.
Other cars on the road.
The time of day.
The condition of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The condition of the road.
questions.explanation: Road condition has a big effect on how well your car can stop. Wet or slippery roads make your car need more distance to stop. Always slow down when road conditions are poor so you can stay in control.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at an open intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The driver on the right has the right-of-way.
The driver on the left has the right-of-way.
One driver may continue driving without stopping.
One driver should honk to show they are giving up the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. The other driver must yield and wait until it is safe to go.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their high beam headlights. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the approaching vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps the bright lights from blinding you. You will still be able to see the road and stay on your path until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Low clearance.
Fines double in a work zone.
No left turn.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns that the space above is low.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass the bicycle.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: A cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully near bicyclists.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
Means you may turn in the direction of the arrow.
Tells you a green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and be ready for a red light.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: You have done enough.
You must wait for the police to arrive.
You must leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
You can leave.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: Try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note. Include your name, address, and details about what happened.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for bicycles ahead.
Bicycles are not allowed here.
A bicycle repair shop is nearby.
Bicycles always have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead. You should be alert and prepared to share the road safely.

questions.question: What is the purpose of regulatory signs?

options.text: They are placed at every dangerous location.
They tell you what you must do or must not do.
They are diamond-shaped with yellow or green color.
They warn you about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell you what you must do or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white. They command drivers to follow traffic laws. These signs show speed limits, no passing rules, and no turning rules.

questions.question: A load hanging more than ____ beyond the rear of a vehicle must have a red flag during the day.

options.text: One foot
Two feet
Three feet
Four feet

questions.correctAnswerText: Four feet
questions.explanation: If a load hangs more than four feet past the rear of your vehicle, you must attach a red flag at least 12 inches square during daylight. Use red lights at night or when visibility is poor.

questions.question: When exiting a highway, when should you slow down?

options.text: On the main road just before the exit lane.
When you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane early. Slow down only after you are in the exit lane.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching an accident scene?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Keep moving.
Stop if you are involved or if help has not arrived.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Only stop if you are involved in the accident or if emergency help is not there. Keep your focus on the road and continue driving. Watch for people on the side of the road. Do not stop just to look at an accident.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgment of speed and distance becomes wrong.
You are less alert.
You calm down and can concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and can concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes it hard to see clearly. It changes how you judge speed and distance. It also reduces your ability to recover from headlight glare and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: To safely pass a bicycle, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn to let the bicyclist know you're passing.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you can pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Speed ahead and pull in front of the bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: When passing a bicyclist, slow down and give them plenty of space. Bicyclists have less protection than car drivers. Do not crowd them. Passing too quickly can force a bicyclist off the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: An intersection is ahead.
A steep downhill grade is ahead.
The road is winding.
Traffic is merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: You can avoid the risks of drunk driving by:

options.text: Deciding before you drink that you will not drive.
Saying no if someone offers you a drink while you are driving.
Calling a taxi.
Doing any of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Doing any of the above.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid drunk driving is to decide before you drink that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, so it will be harder to make safe choices after drinking.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is roadwork ahead and a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead makes a sharp turn to the right. Slow down before a sharp curve just like you would when turning at an intersection.
